notes.title: Simple Bug Fixes - Instant Crash
notes.notes:
[b]Major bug fixed![/b]

Managed to fix the bug causing the game to crash immediately.

notes.title: [COMING SOON] BRAND NEW GRAPHICAL UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]NEW GRAPHICAL UPDATE[/b]

Soon, I am going to be releasing new UI, improved images, and more cleaner menus. This will make the game look much more modern, smooth, and better as a whole.

We are moving the game away from a purple colour scheme to a more greyish-black colour scheme, with more updated images that are easier to identify.

I am excited to release this graphical update, and I hope you are too,
Thanks!

notes.title: New Social Media profiles + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]New social media profile pictures[/b]

Added a couple more social media profile pictures that can appear during the social media tab

[b]Fixed bug[/b]

Fixed bug to do with settings button showing when replaying the game

notes.title: New *Perks* feature + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]NEW PERKS FEATURE[/b]

Now introducing the new "Perks" feature, choose from 3 new perks (or go with the basic build) to further define your character. Does your player prioritize in agility and pace? Then go for the "Speed Demon" trait. Is your player a brick wall? Go for the "Powerhouse" perk! Want to bring flair and skills to your matches? Why not go for the "Magician" perk!

This new feature adds new ways to play, and new ways to further define your player.

[b]MAJOR BUG FIXES[/b]

Fixed major bugs:
[list]
[*] Stats properly reset after replaying
[*] Fixed settings button appearing after replaying
[/list]

Thats all for now! More content coming soon... (As always)

notes.title: Customization menu improved + Other changes
notes.notes:
[b]CUSTOMIZATION MENU UPDATE[/b]

Updated the customization menu now contains much more space, and is much more polished. It will introduce more features (Soon to be announced), however for now contains a first name entry, last name entry, and character customization.

[b]NEW BACKSTORIES[/b]

In every new career, your character will have a small selection of different backstories your character may have. This gives some more story behind your character and their origins, and why they chose to play football.

[b]REMOVED ITEMS[/b]

[list]
[*] Player nationality: Has no specific use, and now you can be any nationality
[*] No more breakdown in the beginning stating height, trait, etc
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed settings menu with music button glitch
[*] Fixed grammatical errors
[/list]

notes.title: Settings + Audio changes
notes.notes:
[b]NEW SETTINGS MENU[/b]

Added a brand new settings menu, now you can enable / disable the music and the SFX. It is very minimalistic and only has those two options, however as the game grows you can expect more settings to be available.

[b]REDUCED VOLUME[/b]

Simply reduced the volume of the background music so it is more subtle.

notes.title: More Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]UPDATE - MORE BUG FIXES[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed goalkeeper stops and clean sheets glitching
[*] Fixed replay button not replaying properly
[/list]

Should be the final of the main bug fixes now, enjoy!

notes.title: HUGE GRAPHICAL UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]NEW MAJOR GRAPHICAL UPDATE[/b]

In this brand new update, there are a few new things to go over in terms of new features. There are:

[list]
[*] Brand new event images
[*] New text font overhaul
[*] First FootCareer soundtrack
[*] Increased amount of event possibilities
[/list]

[b]Brand new event images[/b]

With the brand new event images update, every event has an image that visualizes the current event to the player, creating a more dynamic yet retro gameplay experience, and enhancing the football career immersion.

There are a total of 10 different images dedicated to specific possible events a football player may go through, in a classic, retro artstyle, so if retro gameplay is something your interested this update is perfect for you!

[b]New text font overhaul[/b]

The font in the game before felt out of place, and it lacked texture. Now, we have introduced a brand new pixel art based font style which fits the game perfectly now, completing the retro simplistic gameplay look.

Now with the font, assets within the game do not feel as out of place as they used to, and now all blend together really nicely!

[b]First FootCareer soundtrack[/b]

Introducing our first FootCareer soundtrack out of a planned 5, it creates more flavour and passion when you simulate your career and immersing you deeper into the gameplay, it truely brings a fresh new feeling to the game

[b]Brand new event possibilities[/b]

There are now some more possible events your player can go through! There are now a variety of shoe and energy drink companies that can sponsor your players, and different things like parties and sickness that cann effect your players form and dynamic within the team.
